changelog: Spoken punctuation now understands phone, username and maths symbols: say "plus sign" for + ("call me plus sign eight eight zero" starts with +), "underscore" for _ ("samir underscore pro" becomes samir_pro), "asterisk" for *, "ampersand" for & and "equals sign" for =. In Bengali, say "যোগ চিহ্ন", "আন্ডারস্কোর", "তারকা চিহ্ন", "অ্যাম্পারস্যান্ড" and "সমান চিহ্ন". Works in the app and in the voice keyboard, only when the spoken-punctuation setting is on.
